name: Iris
source:
"I'm glad! I thought I was dead because..."

A Gothic Lolita girl with a lovely face and voice who got lost in the game like Meguru. She is weak and has no power, but it seems that you have to protect her...?

[Translated from [url=https://blulunetta.web.fc2.com/pistole/story.html#iris]official website[/url]]
